family: 14-3-3 is a constitutive homodimer (PMID 9428519); each protomer has its own amphipathic groove that binds one phosphopeptide, so the biological unit with saturating peptide is A2B2
homolog_assemblies: the 23 exact-sequence 14-3-3 gamma entries (residudes structures H1388, e.g. 2B05, 6A5S, 6S9K, 6ZBT) are crystal structures of the dimer or of a protomer related to its partner by crystal symmetry, with one peptide per groove; the peptide contacts a single protomer, so an A1B1 model contains the whole peptide interface
n_sweep: not run: the copy numbers are declared (rule 5, stage-2 style override); a peptide:14-3-3 sweep beyond 1:1 and 2:2 has no biological basis
seq2symm: not run (declared count; B is a known C2 dimer)
reading: A1B1 is what is scored; A2B2 is the biological assembly and is kept as an auxiliary run only to check that the peptide pose in one groove is the same with the dimer partner present
